div.head: Af 36.1[b]
div.ab: Gif hine mon teo gewealdes on ðære dæde, getrywe hine be ðæm wite ond mid þy þæt wite afylle,
gif hine mon tio gewealdes on ðære dæde, getriowe hine be þam wite ⁊ mid ðy þæt wite afelle,
Et si possibilitatis accusetur in eo facto, purget se iuxta modum wite, et ita remaneat de wita,
Gif hine mon tio gewealdes on ðære dæde, getriowe hine be þam wite ⁊ mid ðy þæt wite afelle.
If he is accused of violent intention in the deed, let him clear himself by [an oath equal to] the fine, and with that the fine is dismissed,
and if he is accused of deliberate intention in the act, he shall clear himself with an oath equal to the fine, and thereby dismiss the claim for the fine,
Wenn er der Absicht bei dieser That geziehen wird, so schwöre er sich rein mit [Eid,] dem Strafgelde [gleich hoch,] und schlage damit das Strafgeld nieder,
If he is accused of intent in this deed, let him clear himself by [an oath] equal to the fine, and thereby strike down the fine,
